title: Vote: ventilated seats vs sunroof vs 360 camera
hook: You can only pick one. Which feature wins?
caption:
VOTE TIME 🗳️ Your next car can have only ONE of these:

V = Ventilated seats
S = Sunroof
C = 360 camera

Comment one letter. I'll share the results in my stories next week. Bonus points if you tell me why 👇

slides.heading: You can only pick one. Which feature wins?
Ventilated seats
slides.body: Air flows through perforated seats so your back stays dry in Indian summer heat. Comment V.

slides.heading: Sunroof
slides.body: Brighter cabin and that open feel, but in heat and dust many owners rarely open it. Comment S.

slides.heading: 360 camera
slides.body: Tight parking and narrow lanes get much easier with a top-down view. Comment C.

slides.heading: What one survey found
slides.body: 78% of owners picked ventilated seats over a sunroof. Do you agree?

slides.heading: Vote in the comments
slides.body: Comment V, S or C. Results in next week's stories.

slides.heading: Follow @decodethedrive
slides.body: Honest takes on which car tech is actually worth your money in India.
